name: framework-audit-backlog-scope-check-phase
title: Framework audit backlog: scope_check_save PLAN-only evidence hygiene gap
description: Records a LOW-severity framework evidence-hygiene gap observed during the B-c9f5 dirty-gate story series: scope_check_save can only be written in the PLAN phase (command-policy.ts allowedPhases:['PLAN'], config.ts PLAN-only tool list). When a story rolls back TEST→DEV and adds checklist scope, the scope-plan reviewer cannot write a signed scope-check.json and can only pass verbally. The scope-check.json gate is consumed only at PLAN→DEV by story_review, so gate correctness is unaffected — the loss is purely the mechanical evidence of a post-rollback re-scope. This is a tracked backlog item: not to be fixed now, does not block main, and does not affect the B-c9f5 dirty gate closure. Fix direction to analyze later: keep PLAN-only vs split into PLAN planning-scope and later-phase evidence/scope acknowledgment commands.
